story.headline: Dandridge Weds
story.dek: Yogi Dandridge marries Crystal Dandridge; teammates attend
body: Yogi Dandridge of the Brewers married Crystal Dandridge on Saturday at St. Jude's. 14 teammates attended.
The reception was held at a steakhouse near the ballpark. The couple will travel to Niagara Falls during the All-Star break.
More information is expected later this week.
